content: Ubuma Kuruḡa Vazeḡa Fainiro
Iesuꞌa onamiroteꞌea, fureraroteꞌe madaḡanonoꞌo ubuma kuruḡa vazeḡa ꞌahoga horoniro.
Ebu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ḡadiniro, “Rabi, aniꞌa ubumaḡa kuruḡano furerarotaꞌaꞌe ane haḡai sauꞌa uꞌano ga viꞌa moga haḡai sauꞌa uꞌano?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Aꞌe ani mene haḡai sauꞌa ga viꞌa moga haḡai sauꞌa uꞌano, rehano ani ḡabone zamaḡano Badiꞌaꞌa nougenouge gaueꞌeteꞌe vaze ihozoga veize ani ubumaḡa kuruḡano fureraro.
Madaꞌa agaruꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano emeḡeꞌa eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe vazeḡa gau haḡaiꞌuma. Ohereꞌa arine, vazeni ꞌahogaꞌe gauoga mene idaḡa.
E ꞌize raha ꞌada radiuꞌeteꞌe zamaḡanoꞌe eꞌe raha ꞌadi agaḡa.”
Iesuꞌa ꞌouge reiroteꞌe enogano aneꞌa rahao soꞌabidiro, ebu soꞌareḡa hina taḡora haḡadu vaze eꞌe ubuma rana ase ḡuzuhiro.
Ebu aniꞌa niro, “Siloami duꞌura komeꞌa onamadu vuzuꞌoꞌi.” (Siloami hugaꞌe Tuḡuniro.) Ebu vaze eꞌeꞌa onamadu eꞌe vuḡano vuzuꞌirotene, ubumaḡaniꞌa raꞌanadu bare ariro.
ꞌOugadu ane nabudi zu aneꞌa umididoteꞌe ibite horoniroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ḡadimutitiro, “Vaze ꞌadiꞌe ehoradu umide banidoteꞌe vazeḡa, oꞌehe?”
Vaze nuꞌe raenaꞌa, “Oꞌe, aniꞌe vaze eꞌe,” u nuꞌe raenaꞌa, “Mene, ꞌadiꞌe ani heuḡa,” rae reiro. Rehano ani aneꞌa bare ꞌahige rae reiro, “Oꞌe, vaze aꞌe eḡe.”
Zeḡeꞌa ḡadiniro, “Ubumaḡo nougenouge raꞌaneha?”

Aniꞌa naenaeziro, “Iesu rae huneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa taḡora haḡadu ubumahe rana ase ḡuzuheha. Ebu aniꞌa, 'Siloami duꞌura komeꞌa onamadu vuzuꞌoꞌi,' rae eheha. Eꞌanoꞌo e onamadu eꞌea vuzuꞌeha ebu ehamanogaꞌe idaraneha.”
Zeḡeꞌa ḡadiniro, “Vaze aꞌe noumao?” Aneꞌa ziro, “E aḡuꞌa.”
Farisea Azaḡaꞌe Ubuma Kuruḡa Vazeḡaniꞌa Manoriroteꞌe moneo Udahiro
Ebu ze ibite ubuma kuruḡa reiroteꞌe vazeḡa zamahanadu Farisea azaḡa vaḡe onamiro.
Iesuꞌa taḡora haḡadu vaze eꞌe ubuma fainiroteꞌe madaḡaꞌe Bana Madaḡa.
Eꞌanoꞌo Farisea azaḡaniꞌa zu ḡadiniro, “Ḡa nougenouge ehamanogaꞌe idaraneha?” Aniꞌa naenaeziro, “Aneꞌa taḡora haḡadu ubumahe rana ase ḡuzuheha. Ebu e vuzuꞌadu izidi ehamuꞌohe.”

Ebu Farisea azaḡa nuꞌa reiro, “Vaze aꞌe mene Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo ariroteꞌe vazeḡa, mazaḡa ani Bana Madaḡa goro ḡoeꞌa mene hegoteꞌohe.” U nuꞌe reiro, “Aniꞌe haḡai sauꞌa vazeḡa reine, haḡai nu badeḡa ꞌahiguḡa haḡaogaꞌe mene idaḡa.” ꞌOugadu ze zeḡeꞌa bare rovotiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo ze ubuma kuruḡa reiroteꞌe vazeḡa bare ḡadiniro, “Ani ubumaḡo faineha. Ḡaꞌe ani iniu rae zamareꞌohe?” Aniꞌa naenaeziro, “Aniꞌe peroveta vazeḡa.”
Iuda azaḡa boroboroꞌa ani ibite ubuma kuruḡa reiroteꞌe zu izidi ehamanoga idararoteꞌe mene mae ḡihiniro. Eꞌanoꞌo ze ani viꞌa moga huze zouziro.
Ebu zeḡeꞌa ḡadiziro, “ꞌAhiꞌe zae ubudehe? Aniꞌe hube ubumaḡa kuruḡano furerarohe? Ani nougadu izidiꞌe hena ehamuꞌohe?”
Viꞌa moganiꞌa naenaeziro, “Oꞌe, aniꞌe emeḡe ubude, ebu ani ubuma kuruḡano furerarotaꞌaꞌe emeꞌe edeḡa.
Rehano eme aḡuꞌa, ani nougenouge izidi ehamuꞌohe zu iniuꞌa ubumaḡa faineha. Nugo ḡadinoꞌi. Ani vaze boro ꞌahine, aneꞌa bare ḡoeriꞌuma.”
Ani viꞌa moganiꞌa Iuda azaḡa boroboro rihoziroteꞌe uꞌano, ꞌouge reiro. Mazaḡa zeḡeꞌa raenaꞌa, “Iniuꞌa Iesuꞌe Keriso rae reine, ani nu'onu'o neḡanonoꞌo mae vaḡiniꞌuma,” rae ziro.
Eꞌanoꞌo viꞌa moganiꞌa, “Aniꞌe vaze boro, eꞌanoꞌo ani ḡadinoꞌi,” rae reiro.
Mada aheuḡano ze ibite ubuma kuruḡa reiroteꞌe vazeḡa hunadu niro, “Badiꞌa ubumao huga ḡoeroꞌi.
Emeꞌe edeḡa, Iesuꞌe haḡai sauꞌa vazeḡa.”
Aneꞌa naenaeziro, “E aḡuꞌa, aniꞌe haḡai sauꞌa vazeḡa ga mene, rehano e ḡau tibaꞌe edeḡa. Ibite e ubuma kuruḡa vazeḡa, rehano izidi ehamuꞌohe.”
Zeḡeꞌa ḡadiniro, “Ani ḡa mazao nagini haḡaeha? Nougenouge faiꞌadu ubumaḡo raꞌaneha?”
Aniꞌa naenaeziro, “E amahi zeha, rehano za mene egeha. Nougadu eḡe ḡoere bare igihi raꞌohe? Zae zuni ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa reihi raꞌehe?”
ꞌOugadu ze ani rae sausauniro ebu niro, “Ḡaꞌe ane tahiꞌa, u emeꞌe Mose tahiꞌatahiꞌa!
Eme Badiꞌaꞌa Mose ḡorenirotaꞌaꞌe edeḡa, rehano eme vaze aꞌe noumanoꞌo arirotaꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa.”
Vaze eꞌeꞌa naenaeziro, “E zaguzagauꞌohe! Aniꞌa ubumahe manoneha, rehano za ani noumanoꞌo arirotaꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa!
Emeꞌe edeḡa, Badiꞌaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa azaḡa ḡoereꞌe mene igiꞌohe, rehano iniu ane mazao kurauꞌeteꞌe zu ane urao haḡaeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ḡoereꞌe igiꞌohe.
Badiꞌaꞌa raha ꞌadi haḡairoteꞌe madaḡanonoꞌo onao izidi, ubuma kuruḡano fureraroteꞌe vazeḡa fainiroteꞌe hariḡa vazeni ꞌahoga mene igiro.
Vaze ꞌadiꞌe mene Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo reifone, ani ḡau ꞌahoga haḡaoga mene idaḡa reifo.”
Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Ḡaꞌe fureraroteꞌe madaḡanonoꞌo haḡai sauꞌaniꞌa iriꞌaveꞌohe. Ḡaeꞌa eme ihofihi raꞌehe?” Ebu ze ani hegone buniro.
Vine moneo Ubuma Kuruḡa Azaḡa
Iesuꞌa ze ubuma kuruḡa vazeḡa eꞌe hegone buniroteꞌe igiro. Eꞌanoꞌo ani vaḡadu hidirotene ḡadiniro, “Ḡa Vaze Ubuga mazao fieꞌehe?”
Vaze eꞌeꞌa naenaeniro, “Vaze boro, aniꞌe iniu? Ḡa ihine, e ani mazao fiꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Ḡaꞌa ani horoneha zu ani izidi ḡae teite ḡoereꞌohe.”
Vaze eꞌeꞌa niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, e ḡae mazao fieꞌohe!” Ebu aneꞌa ḡuḡuradu ani mazao kuraro.
Iesuꞌa niro, “Eḡeꞌa kotazoga veize raha ꞌadi ariro. Aꞌe ubuma kuruḡa azaḡaniꞌa ehamanoga veize, zu ehamuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ubumaꞌa kuranoga veize raꞌohe.”
Ebu Iesu teite radiroteꞌe Farisea azaḡa nuꞌe ani ḡoere egadu niro, “Emeꞌe mene ubuma kuruḡa azaḡa!”
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Za hube hune ubuma kuruḡa azaḡa reifone, Badiꞌaꞌa haḡaize sauꞌa rae modifo. Rehano zaꞌe ehamuꞌohe rae raꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, haḡaize sauꞌaꞌe mene rae modeꞌohe.”
